oneOf.description: The page saved by itself after an edit.

baseHash.description:
The `hash` of the version the edit started from (`file.read.hash`); a file that changed since is not
written (`conflict`).

session.description:
The page's name for this editing session (at most 128 characters). Only a hint: the companion decides when a
session ends (10 minutes without a write to the file) and keeps one "before" copy per session.

text.description:
The whole new text, with `
` line ends (`
` and `` are read as `
`); the file keeps its own
encoding, byte order mark and line ends.

hash.description: The new version of the file (the same hash as `file.read.hash`).

protected.description: The rule that marks the file as running code (hooks, tool settings), or null.

summary: Writes a file's new text if the file is still the version `baseHash` names (else `conflict`); keeps its encoding, byte order mark and line ends, and a "before" copy first.
